additional_concerns: node.b66b3e831bb98a12db59dffa omits the transition for pending applications: source unit d97b56331f41a.u10.1809 states, “Existing applications received by the SFC before the Effective Date for which no approval or authorisation has been granted will be processed by the SFC in accordance with the existing approval or authorisation process.”

The other seven candidates treat a pending pre-effective application as categorically excluding relief; the source expressly preserves the existing processing procedure, but does not expressly establish a permanent substantive exclusion irrespective of subsequent application history.

The source establishes 28 November 2025 as the effective date but does not resolve every legally relevant event-date question; an assessment-date input alone cannot settle disputed transitional cases.
The referenced FAQs and existing approval process are not supplied, limiting verification of their additional requirements and transitional operation.
